I'll be hunting for treasure here
tomorrow, too.{VAR BE01}
I may find something, so if you have
time, stop by.

Wingull flew away looking happy!
...Oh? Something is on the ground.{VAR BE01}

This Wingull looks like it lost three Grams
on Route 13. I wish I could help it...

Oh, great! Could that be the Gram?
Let's show it to Wingull!{VAR BE01}

We've got them all!
This helps Wingull a lot!{VAR BE01}

Eh? What's that?
A letter fell from the sky?

I see. That Wingull was working hard
for us, too!

Why did the letter I mailed
fall from the sky...?
